basics.name: Anand Bhaskaran
basics.label: Senior Forward Deployed Engineer · Agentic AI, Integrations & Automation · Production Evals & Observability · Founder
basics.summary: Forward deployed engineer who turns messy, real-world requirements into production AI. Through my practice, Anand Creations, I embed with teams, run discovery, and ship agentic workflows, integrations, and automations that connect a platform to customers' live systems (Salesforce, HubSpot, event streams, APIs). I build for production, not demos: eval harnesses, guardrails, granular tracing, and cost-per-request telemetry, with reusable modules distilled from each engagement. 13+ years shipping software to 10M+ users on multi-tenant SaaS; at LumApps my agent deployments 2x conversions and forecast $1M in quarterly revenue; at Beekeeper I replaced $337K in cost with an LLM pipeline gated by evals.

work.name: LumApps
work.summary: Lead developer for production AI agents. Turns open-ended customer problems into shipped, integrated, observable systems. Reports to C-level on outcomes.
highlights: Shipped production agentic workflows (Python, LangGraph, MCP) that integrate with Salesforce and internal systems and perform real end-to-end tasks. 2x conversions, forecast $1M in quarterly revenue.
Built AI Brain: event-driven ingest over Pub/Sub from 5+ systems (Salesforce, HubSpot, product usage) into a knowledge-graph and RAG retrieval layer. Data pipelines plus retrieval, done right.
Owned reliability in production: eval harnesses, guardrails, granular tracing, and cost-per-request telemetry, from discovery through rollout.

work.name: Beekeeper AG
work.summary: Technical lead who shipped and owned production AI on a multi-tenant SaaS used by millions, and turned one-offs into reusable capability.
highlights: Replaced $337K in annual vendor cost with an in-house LLM pipeline gated by evaluation frameworks that measured quality before anything shipped.
Built a GenAI system that integrates Salesforce and live customer data into automated workflows: tool integration and automation end to end.
Owned architecture, reliability, and instrumentation for products used by 10M+ users on a multi-tenant SaaS (Kafka event streams, PostgreSQL, Kubernetes, AWS).
Turned solutions into reusable capability (a distributed templating engine now powering 15% of platform assets) and mentored the engineers who extended them.

work.name: Tenity
work.summary: Technical advisor and mentor for seed-to-VC stage startups, running discovery and turning ambiguity into direction.
highlights: Ran structured technical discovery across 20+ startups: constraints, success criteria, and architecture, translating ambiguity into clear plans.
Advised on AI strategy and reliability, and mentored teams to ship.

work.name: Dronistics
work.summary: Founding engineer for an autonomous drone delivery system. Built the platform, real-time APIs, and cloud stack from scratch, and owned it in production.
highlights: Built real-time APIs and integrations and owned them in production (debugging, instrumentation, on-call). 500+ deliveries, 99.5% safety record, zero incidents.
Built the cloud infrastructure and CI/CD from scratch; reliability that enabled partnerships with Unilever and a CES showcase.

work.name: EPFL, Laboratory of Intelligent Systems (Robogen)
work.summary: Machine learning research at the frontier of robotics, built and scaled on AWS.
highlights: Built Robogen, an open-source ML platform, and scaled it on AWS. Secured AWS Cloud Credits for Research; featured on the AWS Public Sector Blog.
Foundational AI experience (optimization, search, evaluation) that informs how I reason about agent behavior and its failure modes today.

_jobApplication.jobDescription: Remote (global employment / HR platform), fully remote (NORAM), ~10% travel. Forward Deployed Engineer (AI) on Remote Build / Customer Engineering: work directly with customers and internal stakeholders to design, build, and deploy AI-powered solutions connecting Remote's platform to customer systems and workflows. Turn messy real-world requirements into production-grade implementations via integrations, automations, and agentic workflows; translate field learnings into reusable patterns and product roadmap inputs. High autonomy, ownership from discovery to production; ship systems that are reliable, observable, secure, measurable; intersection of Product, Engineering, Sales/CS, and customers. Must have: shipping production software (backend and/or full-stack) and owning it in production (on-call, debugging, instrumentation); strong integration and systems thinking (APIs, event-driven systems, webhooks, auth OAuth/service accounts, data modeling, idempotency, failure modes); applied AI/LLM beyond prototypes (prompt+tool design, RAG and retrieval, evaluation, latency/cost trade-offs, reliability); operate in ambiguity from problem statement to shipped solution; clear structured written communication. Nice to have: enterprise environments (security reviews, compliance, procurement, change management); agent frameworks / workflow orchestration; HRIS, payroll, IAM or adjacent domains; multi-tenant SaaS, RBAC, data privacy by design. Responsibilities: run structured technical discovery and define done; translate open-ended problems into technical designs (architecture, data flows, integration surfaces, security, rollout); build AI-enabled solutions integrating customer systems and Remote's platform (data pipelines, workflow automations, tool integrations, agentic services); own deployments (reliability, performance, observability, incident response); develop evaluation and measurement (success metrics, test harnesses, golden datasets, regression suites, guardrails); work with real data to quantify impact; collaborate with Product/Engineering and upstream reusable components; turn one-offs into repeatable playbooks, reference architectures, templates, internal tooling; be the voice of the field.
_jobApplication.notes: Very strong fit: FDE practice (Anand Creations); production agentic workflows + integrations (Salesforce/HubSpot, event-driven Pub/Sub, APIs); evals/guardrails/tracing/cost-per-request; production ownership on multi-tenant SaaS at 10M+ users (Beekeeper); reusable playbooks/reference architectures; ambiguity-to-shipped; strong written communication (published tutorials/case studies). Nice-to-have gaps not fabricated: no direct HRIS/payroll domain experience (broad enterprise + fintech/compliance instead); RBAC not explicitly demonstrated (multi-tenant SaaS and data-privacy-by-design via SwissNRI are present).
